description: You are a Robotics Engineer at a company building a 6-DOF robot arm. Design a parametric stepper motor mount for NEMA 17 motors to be used at the elbow and shoulder joints. The NEMA 17 standard (per NEMA ICS 16) specifies: 42.3mm x 42.3mm motor body, 4 x M3 mounting holes arranged in a 31mm x 31mm square pattern centered on the shaft axis, and a 22mm diameter shaft collar boss for alignment. The mount will attach to standard V-slot 2020 aluminum extrusion (20mm slot pitch). The final design must be fully parametric: all critical dimensions (motor hole pattern, bore diameter, base thickness, frame hole spacing) must be defined as named parameters in a Spreadsheet so the mount can be adapted for different motor frame sizes without redrawing. The mount must provide both motor-side attachment geometry and robot-frame-side attachment holes. Log in as ga / password123. Save the parametric FreeCAD model to /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/motor_mount.FCStd and export the solid body as STL to /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/motor_mount.stl for 3D-printing validation.
